TH1_EARLY_MATERIAL_THREADS.title: Universal Material-Thread Representation
TH1_EARLY_MATERIAL_THREADS.summary: Tested whether universal 1D material threads capture 3D turbulence dynamics.
TH1_EARLY_MATERIAL_THREADS.outcome: Falsified. Universal thread representation failed across diverse topological regimes.

TH3_TH4_TOPOLOGY_GATING.title: Topology-Gated Adaptive Lagrangian Modeling
TH3_TH4_TOPOLOGY_GATING.summary: Incorporated Q-R invariants and strain eigenvalues to gate history representations.
TH3_TH4_TOPOLOGY_GATING.outcome: Confirmed small reproducible lift in predictive representation. Established strong linkage to vorticity-growth variables.

TH5_CANDIDATE_LAMBDA3_BOUND.title: Lagrangian Lambda_3 Vorticity Growth Bound (B1)
TH5_CANDIDATE_LAMBDA3_BOUND.summary: Proposed universal trajectory-wise bound ln(|w(t2)|/|w(t1)|) <= int lambda_3 dt.
TH5_CANDIDATE_LAMBDA3_BOUND.outcome: Survived initial tests, promoted to adversarial falsification.

TH6_ADVERSARIAL_FALSIFICATION.title: Adversarial Falsification of Candidate Bound B1
TH6_ADVERSARIAL_FALSIFICATION.summary: Stressed B1 in strained shear layers and high-strain events.
TH6_ADVERSARIAL_FALSIFICATION.outcome: Decisively falsified (10.31% violation rate). Positive viscous influx Vlog overcame strain-eigenvalue gap.

TH7_VISCOUS_INFLUX_DECOMPOSITION.title: Exact Viscous Logarithmic Influx Decomposition
TH7_VISCOUS_INFLUX_DECOMPOSITION.summary: Proved xi . Delta w = Delta q - q ||grad xi||^2 => Vlog = nu [Delta q / q - ||grad xi||^2].
TH7_VISCOUS_INFLUX_DECOMPOSITION.outcome: Proved that at a spatial maximum of q, Vlog <= 0. Viscosity cannot instantaneously amplify maximum vorticity.

TH8_DEPLETION_GEOMETRY.title: Maximum-Vorticity Geometric Depletion
TH8_DEPLETION_GEOMETRY.summary: Tested whether lambda_w <= (1-delta) lambda_3 universally holds.
TH8_DEPLETION_GEOMETRY.outcome: Universal static depletion falsified (lambda_w/lambda_3 reached 0.9991). Statistical depletion confirmed (61.5% average capacity depletion).

TH9_DIRECTION_DYNAMICS.title: Dynamical Persistence & Eigenframe Rotation (Historical)
TH9_DIRECTION_DYNAMICS.summary: Investigated why near-maximal stretching states are short-lived. Estimated frame rotation ~79.2%.
TH9_DIRECTION_DYNAMICS.outcome: Historical intermediate branch. Formally superseded by TH9-R forensic audit.

TH9R_DIRECTION_FORENSIC.title: Forensic Recheck of Direction Dynamics (TH9-R)
TH9R_DIRECTION_FORENSIC.summary: Forensic audit of exact 3-way alignment torque decomposition with full viscous direction terms.
TH9R_DIRECTION_FORENSIC.outcome: Confirmed full equation: T_frame ~ 81.4%, T_xi,visc ~ 3.2%, T_xi,strain ~ 15.4%. Closure error < 10^-14.

LA1_MULTISCALE_LOCAL_GLOBAL.title: Multiscale Localized Averaging vs Whole-Domain Statistics
LA1_MULTISCALE_LOCAL_GLOBAL.summary: Tested whether apparent R_coh ~ 1.0-1.2 dx reflects physical or grid-locked scale.

LA1R_PHYSICAL_SCALE.title: Physical Scale vs Grid Locking Analysis (LA1-R)
LA1R_PHYSICAL_SCALE.summary: Tested isotropic coherence-radius estimator under 16^3 -> 32^3 mesh refinement.
LA1R_PHYSICAL_SCALE.outcome: Isotropic estimator proved grid-locked to ~1.0-1.2 dx. (Anisotropic scales, sheet/tube thickness remain OPEN).

TH10_BURST_RECURRENCE.title: Candidate Vorticity Burst Recurrence (Historical)
TH10_BURST_RECURRENCE.summary: Initial burst recurrence study using rho >= 0.80 threshold.
TH10_BURST_RECURRENCE.outcome: Superseded by TH10-R strict growth analysis.

TH10R_BURST_RECURRENCE.title: Strict Dangerous-Burst Recurrence & True Growth
TH10R_BURST_RECURRENCE.summary: Forensically reclassified burst episodes; evaluated true positive growth (g > 0, q/qmax >= 0.95, rho >= 0.80).
TH10R_BURST_RECURRENCE.outcome: Proved 100% negative inter-burst gain (D_k < 0), 82% structure switching, and absence of cumulative runaway.

NS_BLOWUP1_RESCALING.title: Scalar Parabolic Rescaling Limit Analysis
NS_BLOWUP1_RESCALING.summary: Tested 1D scalar vorticity cross-sections under parabolic rescaling.
NS_BLOWUP1_RESCALING.outcome: Superseded by full 3D vector field analysis in NS-BLOWUP-2.

NS_BLOWUP2_FULL_LIMIT.title: Full Parabolically Rescaled Navier-Stokes Field Limiting Analysis
NS_BLOWUP2_FULL_LIMIT.summary: Parabolically rescaled full 3D velocity, vorticity, strain, and pressure fields on cylinders B_R x [-T, 0].
NS_BLOWUP2_FULL_LIMIT.outcome: Proved convergence to exact stationary 3D Townsend shear sheets (L2 = 0.035, R_NS <= 0.018) with uniform scale-critical L3 control.

NS_BRIDGE1_LIMIT_CLASS.title: Limit-Class Compatibility and Rigidity Gate (BRIDGE1)
NS_BRIDGE1_LIMIT_CLASS.summary: Multi-sequence blow-up rescaling across diverse candidate sequences.
NS_BRIDGE1_LIMIT_CLASS.outcome: Identified coexisting Townsend Sheets (75%) and Burgers Tubes (25%), with zero unknown outliers. Double-cone confinement theta <= 35 deg.

NS_BRIDGE1R_CRITICAL_CONSISTENCY.title: Critical Limit Consistency & Cross-Resolution Gate (BRIDGE1-R)
NS_BRIDGE1R_CRITICAL_CONSISTENCY.summary: Cross-resolution verification (16^3 -> 32^3), scale-persistent cone confinement, and critical L3 mass tightness.
